Agent Name: Local_Knowledge_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly identify the gyms within 200 meters of Tompkins Square Park. The actual gyms in the immediate vicinity (such as CrossFit East River and Avea Pilates) were not found or included in the initial list (which only contained Blink Fitness, TMPL, and East Side Athletic Club). This initial data retrieval error led to checking the wrong set of locations, resulting in an incorrect conclusion that no such gyms exist.
